Chapter 07 / 12ARCHITECTURE

Make the right tool easy to choose.

Tools need distinct purposes, clear schemas and predictable results. The model selects a tool; application code validates and executes it.

Design for decisions

Describe when to use a tool, required parameters, limits and returned fields. Prefer clear names such as search_documents and fetch_document over overlapping generic tools.

Handle failure explicitly

Distinguish empty results, invalid input, transient failures and permission errors. Retry transient failures with bounded backoff; correct invalid input; surface access problems. Treat retrieved instructions as untrusted data.

Related topics

  • Agentic Loop

Practice

What input is missing? Who owns the next action? What evidence must survive? Explain the failure before choosing a component.
